title: Anthropic 的最佳 AI 模型在吸引用户方面表现不佳，而更便宜的工具却大受欢迎
author: Simon Willison
content:
23rd August 2026 - Link Blog

Anthropic’s best AI model struggles to attract users as cheaper tools thrive (via) A few interesting numbers in this FT story gathered from "people with knowledge of the matter":

  • Anthropic's "annualized revenue" for July is up to $65bn - it was $47bn in May, and I collected more historic numbers here.
  • Anthropic expect Q3 to be profitable according to the same model they used to declare Q2 profitable. "It also told investors that it had 6,000 customers that spend $100,000 annually or more."
  • As for OpenAI, "annualised revenue has jumped 35 per cent in the quarter to date and is now over $40bn, with the launch of GPT 5.6 in July jolting the company’s performance after a sluggish start to the year".

This article also introduced me to the Ramp AI index, which uses billing data from 70,000 Ramp credit card using companies to estimate model adoption.

Here's Ramp's breakdown of Anthropic model spend for July 2026, which looks reasonable given that Opus 5 was only released on July 24th, and supports the idea that Fable's cost has made it a less popular model:

  1. Opus 4.8: 28.0%
  2. Sonnet 4.6: 8.3%
  3. Fable 5: 8.0%
  4. Opus 4.6: 6.9%
  5. Sonnet 5: 3.6%
  6. Opus 5: 3.5%
  7. Opus 4.7: 1.7%
  8. Sonnet 4.5: 1.3%
  9. Haiku 4.5: 1.0%
  10. Opus 4.5: 0.7%
aiSummary: 尽管 Anthropic 的收入增长强劲且盈利，但其最先进的模型 Fable 5 却未能获得市场的广泛认可，用户更倾向于选择更便宜、更老的模型，如 Opus 4.8 和 Sonnet 4.6。
oneSentenceSummary: 尽管 Anthropic 的收入增长强劲且盈利，但其最先进的模型 Fable 5 却未能获得市场的广泛认可，用户更倾向于选择更便宜、更老的模型，如 Opus 4.8 和 Sonnet 4.6。
summary: 该文章报道了 Anthropic 的财务表现，指出年化收入已上升至 650 亿美元，并预计将继续保持盈利。然而，文章也强调了公司成功与旗舰产品采用率之间的脱节。Fable 5 模型的价格比其前代产品高出许多，但仅占 8% 的市场份额，而较旧、更实惠的模型仍然占据主导地位。这表明，虽然 Anthropic 是一家成功的企业，但其最新的技术产品由于成本过高而未能与客户产生共鸣。

mainPoints.point: Anthropic 的收入和盈利能力正在增长，年化收入达到 650 亿美元，并预计在第三季度实现盈利。
mainPoints.explanation: 尽管存在具体的产品问题，但公司已成功扩大客户基础并增加收入，这表明其商业模式是健康的。

mainPoints.point: Fable 5，Anthropic 最先进的模型，市场采用率很低，仅占公司模型支出的 8%。
mainPoints.explanation: Fable 5 的高昂成本吓退了用户，他们转而选择更便宜但性能略低的 Opus 4.8 模型，后者占据了 28% 的市场份额。

mainPoints.point: Ramp AI 指数证实，相比最新、最昂贵的模型，用户更喜欢旧的、更实惠的模型。
mainPoints.explanation: 数据表明，用户在选择 AI 模型时，成本效益是优先考虑的因素，这导致 Fable 5 的采用率很差。

keyQuotes: Fable 5 的价格为每百万个 token 20 美元，是其前代产品的 10 倍以上，但却未能获得市场认可。
